title: Amazon issues refunds from a 2025 settlement, crediting "President Trump's Federal Trade Commission," the first time an FTC refund has been tied to a president (Alfred Ng/Politico)
summary: Alfred Ng / Politico: Amazon issues refunds from a 2025 settlement, crediting “President Trump's Federal Trade Commission,” the first time an FTC refund has been tied to a president — Millions of Americans are expected to receive a settlement check from Amazon credited to “President Trump's Federal Trade Commission” …
contentText:
Alfred Ng / Politico :

Amazon issues refunds from a 2025 settlement, crediting “President Trump's Federal Trade Commission,” the first time an FTC refund has been tied to a president   —  Millions of Americans are expected to receive a settlement check from Amazon credited to “President Trump's Federal Trade Commission” …
